counting_rule: A directional outcome, output load, ID, prepared channel or inherited catalogue entry is not counted as a new primitive. ANTES/DESPUES share one bounded order mechanism. FORMA_01 and FORMA_02 are two operational sign protocols, each with directional outcomes; not two demonstrated NSM primitives.

source_summary_preserved.scope: Evidence index over existing cases, not new Native executions or an operational response dictionary

native_profiles.capability: Two physical event orders alter a relative body and native early output; later physical access can re-express part of that history.
native_profiles.prepared: N67 sensor ports A/B, basal phase260, guide and common reader; the participant is not given a precomputed before/after bit.
native_profiles.acquired: Different admitted event histories AB/BA; initial delta and emitted direction differ.
native_profiles.domain: Specific A/B referents, onset0, gap1, first reader2/output5; renewed access69 and cadence-sensitive alternatives.
native_profiles.limit: A/B-order operational discrimination is not a general abstraction of ANTES/DESPUES across arbitrary identities and intervals; two signs of one relation are not two independently acquired primitives.

late_post_R2_use.domain: Two same-age110 parents, original historiesAB/BA and newQ- content already acquired at90 in distinct prepared banks. Third/final bounded access family.
late_post_R2_use.mechanism: A fixed interface at center-2z is declared inertly at110; new probes110/111 are applied without clearing cells. Their local route/persistence profiles differ by whole history afterR2.
late_post_R2_use.observed: Both first responses111 share(-1,-1,-1); AB then has a recorded outgoing17 carrier in neighboring(32,24,30) at112, whileBA maintains a local17 field. Both no-query shams remain empty.
late_post_R2_use.scope: A real new physical interaction afterR2 and preserved R1/R2 deltas, not a new abstract ANTES/NO predicate or proof that one scalar uniquely causes the contrast.

native_profiles.capability: A native information product reaches and writes a second relative support; its subsequent answer depends on that acquired relation.
native_profiles.prepared: Second support fromT0 at(44,53,30), open B landing, phase171; no trained state installed.
native_profiles.acquired: Native contact90 changes delta to+1 for Q- and-1 for Q+; queued physical query94 emits opposite directions97.
native_profiles.domain: Right-mismatch Q path in N67; support geometry and phase171 are essential.
native_profiles.limit: Measured native contact/write and causal intervention; the word TOCAR has not been taught as a general relational predicate.

native_profiles.capability: Different source experiences produce native communicated content, late physical use, and a second acquired relation while original history remains physically available.
native_profiles.prepared: Finite reflected-Y controller and source routes; each candidate source receives separate exposures. Positive-Q requires extra contributors.
native_profiles.acquired: Q content is acquired by paired physical exposures, selected/used through v27, retained in R2; not chosen by a Python target table.
native_profiles.domain: Finite source-policy and communication opportunities, not an arbitrary reusable question-answer network.
native_profiles.limit: Usable received information does not by itself demonstrate metaknowledge SABER or the full semantics of DECIR.

native_profiles.capability: A later fixed opaque sign re-expresses received directional content through a real physical query.
native_profiles.prepared: Equal simultaneous dose on all candidate language lanes; the interface chooses no content-dependent correct branch.
native_profiles.acquired: Paired sign exposure40 with native received carrier43; query50 produces content-dependent output53. Unpaired/omitted controls lack the decoded taught signature.
native_profiles.domain: One opaque sign protocol with two directional outcomes and finite prepared routes. The two directions are not counted as two NSM primitives.
native_profiles.limit: The renderer supplies the literal syntax FORMA_01 and the direction number; no Spanish NSM word, bidirectional language or semantic grammar is thereby established.

later_access_after_second_association.schedule: First FORM_01 query53 -> later FORM_02 association80/query90 -> fresh repeated FORM_01 request117 and native remote supply -> content response162, same MAIN without reset.
later_access_after_second_association.new_prepared_resource: Fixed remote neutral reader ports exist fromT0, both candidate stores stimulated equally. Native delay44 supplies an additional physical query resource; no source/value-selected host routing.
later_access_after_second_association.reserved_variations: BA andAB histories, balanced source codec, event load5, late query13, language query11 and remote reader11. Three positive worlds plus no-repeat and unpaired-name controls.
later_access_after_second_association.physical_outcomes: With common scalar load11, Q- produces native direction(-1,0,-1), Q+ produces(+1,0,-1) in162. No-repeat and unpaired-name controls have no decoded target162; the unpaired first form preserves the second form output90.
later_access_after_second_association.causal_readout: Late carrier cut160 removes target162 while stored R2delta persists; identical sham restores the parent trajectory. Equalizing only A/Bdelta160 does not remove WB02 target162: late access uses richer native expression context, not scalar delta alone.
later_access_after_second_association.decoder_provenance: Discovery V1 used -dx and misread physical polarity. Its errors remain. V2=dx was frozen before the new R03 reserve worlds, not retrospectively relabelled as discovery success.
later_access_after_second_association.scope: Measured reuse of the first operational sign after acquiring the second, using an explicit new reader resource. Not unlimited renewable access, two general NSM primitives, or joint semantic composition.

native_profiles.capability: A second opaque form is taught only after the original order-history function has been physically re-expressed through the renewed reader.
native_profiles.prepared: Both candidate dy-sign routes and equal-dose teaching/query inputs exist fromT0; fixed source geometry transports the native69/70 old-history expression to a teaching encounter80.
native_profiles.acquired: Opaque teaching pulse requested77 meets native history product80; common form-only query87 yields output90: AB(1,-1,-1), BA(1,+1,-1), load23. Unpaired and omitted teaching do not produce the decoded signature.
native_profiles.domain: Specific renewed order-history expression, N67, reading69/70, teaching80, query90. The delayed67 query in157 did not re-express the same signature.
native_profiles.limit: One additional bounded opaque association, not the general primitives ANTES/DESPUES. Subsequent remote reader trials establish FORM_01 access again162 after FORM_02 teaching80/query90. FORM_02 delayed access157 remains adverse, and a joint new composition of the two sign meanings is not demonstrated.

separability_contrasts.old_history_constant: WR01 BA/Q- versus WR02 BA/Q+: FORM_01 changes v, FORM_02 remains h=+1.
separability_contrasts.new_content_constant: WR01 BA/Q- versus WR03 AB/Q-: FORM_01 remains v=-1, FORM_02 changes h=+1 to-1.
separability_contrasts.scope: Two operational contents can vary separately over these three reserve cells. This is not a complete four-cell factorial or a new composed sentence.

interfaz_registrada.alcance: W1: forma textual fija, port señal5/-x; no respuesta ni función guardada en el alias

fisica_realizable.alcance: Dominio finito N67, señal5, emisión21 diagonal; no dominio universal de la palabra

asociacion_entrenada.alcance: Misma señal y decoder con historias opuestas; teacher actual externo idéntico a ambas regiones; control sin señal/desacoplado sin emisión. Report omitido rechaza consultas: NO es control de olvido.

retencion.alcance: Adquisición172/200; sonda física236/264 tras64ticks; emisión239/267 tras67ticks. No retención indefinida ni renovación después de la consulta.

reservada.alcance: Traslaciones e historia/orden congelados; NO reparados al observarlos. En orden NO,HAY la segunda forma HAY no expresa21 pese admisión aplicada.

emision.alcance: Emisión significa situación→símbolo, NO respuesta a palabra. MAIN original0símbolos. Método2: HAY sólo después de rescate ambiental diagnóstico y nuevo acceso transversal predeclarado; confirmado fresh y suprimido por corte de memoria. No emisión autónoma de MAIN ni semántica universal.

composicion.alcance: La continuidad A→B→consecuencia→enseñanza externa→respuesta es física, pero no prueba sintaxis NSM. Emisión asistida de HAY no constituye composición de primitivas o bidireccionalidad autónoma en MAIN.

retencion.alcance: Adquisición172/200; sonda física236/264 tras64ticks; emisión239/267 tras67ticks. No retención indefinida ni renovación después de la consulta.

reservada.alcance: Traslaciones e historia/orden congelados; NO reparados al observarlos. En orden NO,HAY la segunda forma HAY no expresa21 pese admisión aplicada.

emision.alcance: Emisión significa situación→símbolo, NO respuesta a palabra. MAIN original0símbolos. No emisión autónoma de MAIN ni semántica universal.

composicion.alcance: La continuidad A→B→consecuencia→enseñanza externa→respuesta es física, pero no prueba sintaxis NSM. Emisión asistida de HAY no constituye composición de primitivas o bidireccionalidad autónoma en MAIN.

scientific_layers.calculations: Counts are catalogue65, related operational profiles5, opaque sign protocols2, and current full primitive claims0. No global intelligence score.
provisional_reading: Experience creates distinctions that remain usable as physical emissions and acquired secondary relations; later signs can re-express received content and a bounded original order-history function.
The current experiment supports a concrete route toward operational semantics, not substitution of a linguistic inventory for an acquired ontology.

Old and new native relations occur in the same MAIN in the longitudinal cases. The late110/111 continuations also execute genuinely new original-region interactions afterR2 acquisition90; their access mechanisms, route profiles and causal sufficiency remain distinct.

The new reserved remote-reader worlds close first-sign use after second-sign learning: FORM_01 at53 -> FORM_02 at90 -> fresh FORM_01 request117/read162. Two contents vary separately in three reserve cells; an entirely new combined semantic query remains open.

Scalar R2delta was causally necessary for early97 signature, whereas its late160 equalization did not change word-bus162 response. Functional memory includes distributed expression context and cannot be reduced to that scalar alone.
Association of fixed opaque forms with native directions is not yet an NSM word, general relation abstraction, bidirectional dialogue, role-preserving grammar or knowledge of arbitrary things.
